description: Source code for the CRExecutionContext class in Playwright, handling JavaScript evaluation and object management within a Chromium remote debugging session.

classes.name: CRExecutionContext
classes.description: Implements JavaScript execution context delegate for Chromium, enabling evaluation, property retrieval, and handle management.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the remote context and returns the result as JSON.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Calls a function with arguments within the remote execution context.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a JavaScript object handle.
